faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to commonly asked questions
faq.q1: What are Scopus and Web of Science?
faq.a1: Scopus and Web of Science (WoS) are two leading international scientific journal databases. Publishing in journals indexed in both databases has become the standard for international research quality and is highly regarded in the evaluation of researcher and institutional academic performance.
faq.a2: Click the "Register" button in the top right corner, fill in your name, email, and password. Registration is free and takes less than a minute. Once signed in, you can immediately submit a consultation.
faq.q3: Is there a fee for consultation?
faq.a3: Yes, each service has a fee that varies according to the scope and complexity of your needs. The fees shown on the services page are temporary. Final fee details will be communicated after the initial consultation.
faq.q4: How long does the consultation process take?
faq.a4: Duration varies depending on the selected service and manuscript condition. Generally, manuscript review takes 3–7 working days, while full accompaniment can take several weeks until the manuscript is ready for submission.
faq.q5: Does Scientia Advantage serve educational institutions?
faq.a5: Yes, we serve individuals (lecturers, Masters/Doctoral students, researchers) as well as institutions (universities, research institutes). Special packages are available for institutional needs. Contact us via WhatsApp for further discussion.
faq.q6: How do I contact the Scientia Advantage team?
faq.a6: You can reach us via WhatsApp at the available number, email to info@scopus-wos-consultant.com, or fill out the contact form on this website. Our team is ready to respond within 1x24 hours on business days.
